verdict.rationale: Steel is itself a browser API with a published OpenAPI spec, documented endpoint references covering sessions, captchas, credentials and files, and the Sessions API, which agents use to spin up isolated browsers on demand. An independent community comment praises the API reference, and a probe confirmed that openapi.json is live. Together these give strong first-party documentation plus independent and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
